name: High-Risk quests are handed out and taken back at the faction call boards
contract: The Hero's Call Board (gameobject 402000, Darnassus) and the Warchief's Command Board (402001, The Crossroads) give and take back the High-Risk dailies from the AscensionDB archive (revision d6494ceb3150, built 2026-09-12). A character under the High-Risk ruleset (aura 1004019) sees the board's available marker and can take quest 50015; a character without it is neither offered nor granted the quest. The accepted quest is finished and handed in at the same board, which pays its 3000 Runes of Descension (item 375250) and marks the daily done for the day. A quest titled For The Horde (980204) is taken only at the Horde board: the Alliance board refuses it and the Warchief's Command Board grants it to a High-Risk Horde character.
